title: Client momentum check-in notes - pre 1:1
content:
Purpose: quick prep notes for upcoming weekly 1:1 with AE (Asha) + CSM handoff. Goal = surface risks, win momentum, lock next milestone (POC completion sign-off)

Context:
- Account: Orbit Retail (mid-market, started POC 2025-09). Primary contacts: Priya Shah (Head of ML), Marcus Lee (Platform Eng).
- Contract: evaluation -> potential pilot commit. Renewal window TBD but procurement signal expected if POC meets latency/cost targets.
- Current ask: finalize throughput benchmark, confirm data path for private deployment, price sensitivity on committed qps.
- Recent: Tech scoping call 2026-02-18 exposed a KV cache mismatch causing ~20% higher tokens than expected. Engineering ticket opened.

Meeting objectives (30m) — order and timebox:
- 0-5m: quick check-in, wins (Asha)
- 5-12m: technical blockers update (me) + engineering ETA
- 12-20m: commercial signal + pricing levers Asha wants to test
- 20-28m: next milestone alignment (deliverables, owners, dates)
- 28-30m: confirm follow-ups and decide if escalation is needed

Prep notes / cues (things to say):
- "Highlight: we reduced p99 tail by 40% on a similar retail workload using batch tuning — could be replicated for Orbit in Dedicated."
- "We found one source of token inflation tied to prefix caching mismatch; SRE flagged a fix that needs a small model reload window."
- "If procurement needs a latency SLA, we can offer a 6-week target with canary in our EU region and fallback routing."

Open technical points to surface to Asha and Priya:
- KV cache mismatch: root cause hypothesis + link to logs (JIRA-3421). Need SRE confirmation of reload window (estimate 45m) and risk to running POC.
- Data path for private deployment: requirement doc sent 2025-11-20 — confirm whether customer will manage KMS or require Redwood-managed keys. If customer-managed, need network runbook and IP allowlist.
- Throughput benchmarking: need to agree on a canonical prompt set (I suggested set v3) — ask Marcus if they can freeze prompt samples by next Tues (2026-03-05).

Commercial / deal items to raise:
- Pricing levers: discuss short-term pilot discount tied to committed qps, and a 3-month milestone credit if latency SLO missed.
- Procurement timing: ask Asha to surface procurement stakeholders and target decision date. Suggest target = end of Q2 (2026-06-30) if benchmarks are green.
- Ask for a small success metric: 99th percentile latency < 250ms at 10 qps with 80-token prompts.

Risks & suggested mitigations (callouts to propose):
- Risk: engineering fix requires model reload causing ~1h visible disruption. Mitigation: schedule small maintenance window with customer and run canary after hours. Offer credit if we miss a milestone.
- Risk: customer insists on customer-managed KMS but timeline slips. Mitigation: offer interim Redwood-managed keys with contract language on migration to customer KMS later.

Immediate action items to propose in-meeting (format: action / owner / due):
- Freeze prompt set v3 / Marcus / 2026-03-05
- Confirm KMS preference and provide network runbook / Priya / 2026-03-06
- SRE confirm reload window estimate & rollback plan / Talia B. / 2026-03-02
- Draft pilot pricing addendum (2 qps discount tiers) / Asha / 2026-03-04
- Schedule maintenance canary (tentative) / Diego / 2026-03-07

Notes to self (tone: informal, quick reminders):
- Keep language empathetic re: SLAs — they care about uptime and procurement timelines more than marginal $ savings.
- Bring up competitor noise: heard they ran a bench with <vendor-x> and saw lower cost but worse p99. Use our A/B bench slide if they push price-first.
- If Priya pushes for full on-prem pilot — flag to Eng that this requires additional security review (SAML cert rotation) and may push pilot >8w.

Post-meeting follow-ups (template to send within 24h):
- Subject: Orbit POC — sync notes + agreed actions (short bullets)
- Include: agreed milestones, owners, dates, links to JIRA and runbook, next meeting time. Ask for confirmation on prompt set and KMS preference.

Helpful links to paste in meeting chat:
- JIRA-3421 (KV cache mismatch): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/JIRA-3421
- Account playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/OD-Account-Playbook
- A/B bench slide: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1aBbench-slides

Backlog thoughts (parking lot):
- Explore offering short-term managed KMS onboarding as a paid service to reduce friction for customers like Orbit.
- Build a one-page canary runbook for quick maintenance windows targeting retail workloads.

Tone & tactics during call (one-liners):
- "We want this POC to build trust quickly — short wins > long architecture debates."
- "If you'd like, we can stand up a short canary in EU this week to prove the latency delta while the main cluster gets the minor fix."

Final checklist before call (5 min):
- [ ] Confirm meeting link + calendar invite (done)
- [ ] Attach prompt set v3 link to invite
- [ ] Upload latest bench summary screenshot to Drive and paste in chat (done)
- [ ] Quick sync with Talia (5m) to confirm SRE availability

Estimated outcome: sync on blockers, commit to prompt freeze, align pricing play, and schedule maintenance canary. If all green, convert to pilot contract draft by 2026-03-20.

-- Diego
